# Linear Regression Slope

*Bar-to-bar change of the least-squares line.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Linear Regression Slope** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `14` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/lrslope.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Linear Regression Slope", shortTitle: "LRS", overlay: false, precision: 6 });
const length = input.int("Length", 14, { min: 2 });
const src = input.source("Source", "close");
plot(ta.calc([ta.linreg(src, length, 0), ta.linreg(src, length, 1)], (a, b) => a - b), { title: "Slope", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero", color: "rgba(120,123,134,0.5)", style: "dashed" });
```
